sloka: पुनः पुनरुपागम्य विरराद भृशं किल ।ततस्त्वं बोधितस्तस्याः शोणितेन समुक्षितः ।। ५.६७.५ ।।।।
transliteration: punaḥ punarupāgamya virarāda bhṛśaṁ kila ।tatastvaṁ bodhitastasyāḥ śoṇitena samukṣitaḥ ।। 5.67.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Again and again the crow came to her and scratched her. She woke you up as you were getting wet with blood shed from her body.
